label: Evaluated games
description: Completed historical games included in the current walk-forward evaluation window.

label: Straight-up accuracy
description: Model accuracy for predicting outright winners.

label: F1 score
description: Balanced precision/recall score for home-win classification.

label: AUC
description: Rank-order separation for home-win probabilities.

label: Brier score
description: Probability accuracy score; lower is better.

label: Log loss
description: Penalty for overconfident wrong probabilities; lower is better.

label: Margin MAE
description: Average absolute error of predicted game margin.

label: Margin RMSE
description: Root-mean-square margin error; penalizes large misses.

label: Vegas favorite accuracy
description: No-vig Vegas favorite accuracy over the same evaluated games.

label: Model/Vegas agreement
description: Share of games where model and no-vig Vegas favorite picked the same side.

label: Disagreement games
description: Games where the model and no-vig Vegas favorite picked opposite sides.

label: Model accuracy in disagreements
description: Model straight-up accuracy only in games where it disagreed with the Vegas favorite.

label: Vegas accuracy in disagreements
description: No-vig Vegas favorite straight-up accuracy in model disagreement games.

label: Model-side moneyline ROI
description: Flat one-unit ROI from betting the model-selected side at listed moneyline odds.

label: Disagreement moneyline ROI
description: Flat one-unit ROI when betting the model side only in favorite-disagreement games.

label: Best spread side
description: Best corrected spread ROI row from the current backtest summary.

label: Best spread edge threshold
description: Best corrected spread ROI row from the current backtest summary.

label: Best spread ROI
description: Best corrected spread ROI row from the current backtest summary.

label: Best spread sample
description: Best corrected spread ROI row from the current backtest summary.

label: Best spread hit rate
description: Best corrected spread ROI row from the current backtest summary.

label: Best spread edge bucket
description: Best corrected absolute spread-edge bucket with minimum sample filter applied.

label: Best spread edge bucket ROI
description: Best corrected absolute spread-edge bucket with minimum sample filter applied.

label: Best spread edge bucket sample
description: Best corrected absolute spread-edge bucket with minimum sample filter applied.

label: Best spread edge bucket hit rate
description: Best corrected absolute spread-edge bucket with minimum sample filter applied.

label: Evaluation start season
description: Lower season bound used for current evaluation artifacts.

label: Live cutoff season
description: Season excluded at and after the live cutoff.

label: Live cutoff week
description: Week excluded at and after the live cutoff.
